source: Perkins Management Services catering guides (Express, Standard, Flair Platinum). Prices are not listed; contact Catering Services to order.
notes: Campus groups submit a signed, approved service request 72 hours before the event.
A 50% deposit is due when you book; the balance is due 24 hours before the event.
Cancellations need a signed function sheet at least 24 hours before the event.
Standard service time is two hours; longer events are billed per extra hour.
Leftover food stays with Perkins for health and safety reasons.
